name: improve-types-section-kind-badges
title: Improve the Types section: kind badges, meta and order
description: Fix the Types list: give every kind a consistent chip (Struct/Bit-field/Enum in sentence case; struct currently has none), replace the flat same-grey badge with per-kind accent styling, enrich the meta line with real numbers (struct byte size, bit-field bit usage), and sort the list kind-grouped then by name. Presentational only; no grouping/filter/search, no row-click, no persisted change.
